Package org.apache.hadoop.ipc

@LimitedPrivate({"HBase","HDFS","MapReduce","YARN","Hive","Ozone"}) @Evolving package org.apache.hadoop.ipc
Tools to help define network clients and servers. Other ASF projects use this package, often with their own shaded/unshaded versions of protobuf messages. Changes to the API signatures will break things, especially changes to RPC and RpcEngine.
